scope: Independent bounded source/evidence review of loader identity repair; no mathematical/scanner/Lean/full-suite replay

findings.title: Freeze declarations before TestCase construction
findings.cause: super().loadTestsFromTestCase instantiates TestCases before remember captures function and code identities. A custom __init__ can alias the second declared method to the first before either snapshot.
findings.observed: Both exact proposed runners return SURVIVED/exit0, invalid_population=[], two distinct selected identities and trace first,first, while the retained failing second method never executes.
findings.fix: Capture class/declaration function/code identities before construction and compare afterward; alternatively refuse custom __init__/__new__/metaclasses before instantiating unsupported TestCases.

findings.title: Enumerate actual module declarations instead of module __dir__
findings.cause: dir(module) invokes a module-owned __dir__, so the advertised declaration-derived population can omit an actual TestCase declaration before any snapshot.
findings.observed: Both exact proposed runners return SURVIVED/exit0 with only Visible.test_first selected, invalid_population=[], and trace first; declared Hidden.test_hidden retains a failing body but never executes.
findings.fix: Enumerate actual module.__dict__ keys/values without module __dir__/__getattr__, or explicitly refuse such population hooks. Refuse custom TestCase metaclasses or derive class method names from actual declarations to avoid the analogous class-dir hook.

observed_evidence_summary.composition: Staged applicable passing method union; not a new whole run. Original failed layer normal receipt retained; one strengthened canonical-population test rerun alone.

new_execution: Exactly four new isolated CLI probes, one constructor-alias and one module-dir omission in each runner; normal mode only. No completed verification repeated.
limits: Trusted ordinary Python test-source/runtime custody remains required. This is not arbitrary malicious-code isolation or universal scanner correctness. Existing mathematical and source-specific evidence is not invalidated.
